corrections.reason: The printed glyph is archaic Amharic 'ሁኗልና' (with second-order 'ሁ', identical to line 10), which was normalized/misread as 'ሆኗልና'.
The printed glyph is 'ሁኗ' (forming 'ሁኗልና' across the line break, with second-order 'ሁ' as in line 10), misread as 'ሆኗ'.

Both visually (the central horizontal bar of 'ፁ' is clearly printed) and philologically (Ge'ez 'ልፁቅ' meaning 'joined/attached', explained on the next line by 'ተላፅቆ' and in Col 2 L15 as 'ልጹቅ'), the word is 'ልፁቅ', not 'ልዑቅ'.
